cd.title: first songs
cd.situation: Open mic night, and nobody has heard of Mira.
cd.today: Mira's 'first songs' went gold. She still plays the shop every Christmas.

actions.label: picked up Mira's dropped demo CD
actions.line: A scratched demo CD: 'MIRA - first songs'. Someone dropped it.

actions.label: played it at the shop's listening post
actions.line: The owner stops sweeping. 'Who IS this?' He pins her flyer up and books her for tonight.
actions.lockedLine: The listening post is free. You have nothing to play.

offline.headline: Mira's Debut Turns Gold, Twenty Years Later
offline.article: Singer Mira's 2004 demo, first played at Hollow Records' listening post, has finally gone gold. She says she owes it all to the shop on the corner.
